title: ee.mesh.grant.v1
description: Successful result of `ee mesh grant <peer-id> --lane <lane>`. Approval verification, canonical-snapshot comparison, generation compare-and-swap, the allow decision, and consent audit commit in one transaction. The response never contains the approval bearer, nonce, keyed snapshot tag, sample bytes, or sample/content hashes.

newGrantGeneration.description: Generation committed by this mutation. It is strictly greater than previousGrantGeneration; replay cannot commit the same generation twice.

auditId.description: Opaque, domain-keyed identifier derived from the approval token's high-entropy nonce. It is not the bearer, snapshot tag, content/sample hash, or sample bytes.

residual.const: A later lane revocation stops future serving but cannot erase bytes the peer already cached or copied.

peerId.description: Opaque enrolled-peer lookup handle. It is not itself a cryptographic identity.
